summary.text: John Morgan is the Democratic candidate for North Carolina House of Representatives District 113, running against incumbent Republican Jake Johnson in the November 3, 2026 general election.

A retired U.S. Air Force lieutenant colonel and former commercial airline pilot, he says in a Ballotpedia survey that he was elected a city commissioner and started a business providing affordable housing.

paragraphs.text: Morgan earned a bachelor's degree from California State University, Long Beach, in 1970 and a graduate degree from Embry-Riddle Aeronautical University in 1982, and served as an officer in the U.S. Air Force from 1972 to 1993.

In a Ballotpedia survey he said he retired as a lieutenant colonel after 21 years in the Air Force, flew reconnaissance missions beginning during the Vietnam War, and later flew Presidents George H. W. Bush and Bill Clinton.
He said he then worked as a commercial airline captain and pilot flight instructor on the Boeing 747.
Morgan said he later ran for and was elected a city commissioner and began a business that provides affordable housing.
He listed affordability, progressive taxation, accessible health care and child care, and full legislative funding of public education as campaign priorities.
